title: Reduction SMP
description: This project is an unique idea for an SMP for friends.
body: This unique SMP plugin gives players a random damage reduction with 75%. There are a lot of different Damage types. Fire Damage, Fall Damage, Generic Mob Damage, Other Mob Damage, Boss Damage and much more! There is also an pvp aspect. Players get both a main damage reduction, and a pvp reduction. There are reductions for Sword Damage, Axe Damage, Mace Damage, Crit Damage, and much more! There are some commands like /rules, /journal and many more! Tip: Use /damage and see the auto completions to see all commands! There is also a reroll function! The Plugin has a config.yml, and i recommend to disable the events, since these are not tested and will probably not work well. There are 2 known bugs: When having Fire Damage reduction, Lava Damage sounds very buggy, gets more silent when putting down the Players Volume. And the Joural has some bugged values when having rerolled a lot.
